system.description:
• Death's Grasp: Once per day, if reduced to 0 HP or below while you have at least one undead under your control, immediately stabilise at 1 HP — your army sustains you at the threshold.
  • Each undead that contributes to this loses 2d6 HP
  • If no undead survive the drain, the ability fails

activities.name: Death's Grasp
activities.text: When reduced to 0 HP or below with undead under your control, stabilise at 1 HP; each contributing undead loses 2d6 HP.
